title: CultureCLIP: Empowering CLIP with Cultural Awareness through Synthetic Images and Contextualized Captions
benchmark_measurement: Recognition and differentiation of culturally-specific concepts, including religious icons, mythological figures, symbols, and festivals.
findings: CultureCLIP significantly improves a model's ability to differentiate between visually similar but culturally distinct concepts, which include religious figures (e.g., Yuelao and Taishang Laojun), symbols, and festival elements. The proposed method of fine-tuning with a synthetic dataset (CulTwin) of concept-caption-image triplets and a tailored contrastive learning objective proved effective, achieving a notable 5.49% improvement over the base CLIP model on a fine-grained concept recognition task while preserving general capabilities.
